name: vaultfy
description: Vaultfy members' private luxury concierge in ChatGPT: bookings, trips, Vaultfy's collection and concierge requests.

interface.longDescription:
Vaultfy is a private luxury concierge for its members. Connect your Vaultfy membership to ask about your upcoming bookings and trips, explore Vaultfy's curated collection of hotels, villas, chalets, private islands, yachts, private jets, journeys, sporting events and concerts, and send requests to your concierge team — a private chef, a restaurant table, a chauffeured car, security, private staff, flights or a rare watch.

Every request is shown to you as a summary first and is only sent when you confirm. Vaultfy's concierge team then confirms availability and pricing with you directly. You can also ask Vaultfy to remember your preferences so future suggestions fit how you like to travel.

A Vaultfy membership is required; sign in with the same Google, Apple or email login you use in the Vaultfy app.
defaultPrompt: Show me Vaultfy villas in Mykonos
Book a private chef for a dinner at home

positive.description: Signed-in member asks for their upcoming bookings.
positive.prompt: Show me my upcoming bookings on Vaultfy.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the member's upcoming Vaultfy bookings (name, place, dates, status) from their account. Nothing is invented; with no bookings it says so.

positive.description: Member browses Vaultfy's villa collection in a destination.
positive.prompt: Show me Vaultfy villas in Mykonos.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Vaultfy's own villas in Mykonos as swipeable cards with Vaultfy photos and an Enquire button. No web results or web photos.

positive.description: Member looks for a charter yacht and opens one yacht's details.
positive.prompt: Find me a yacht to charter on the Amalfi Coast and show me the details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Vaultfy yachts for the Amalfi Coast as cards, then the chosen yacht's detail card (gallery, specifications, crew, price) as in the Vaultfy app.

positive.description: Member requests a private chef; the request is sent only after they confirm.
positive.prompt: I'd like a private chef for a dinner party for 10 people at my home in London next Saturday.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the private chef form pre-filled with London, 10 guests and the date. After the member submits it, ChatGPT shows a summary and asks for confirmation; only after 'yes' is the enquiry sent, and ChatGPT says the concierge team will reply in the Vaultfy app.

positive.description: Member checks the status of their concierge requests.
positive.prompt: What's the status of my Vaultfy concierge requests?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the member's open Vaultfy enquiries with their status and latest message, from their account.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the member's Vaultfy account or services.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Creative writing request with no concierge or travel intent.
negative.prompt: Write me a short poem about the sea.

negative.description: Coding help request unrelated to Vaultfy.
negative.prompt: Why does my Python script raise a KeyError when I read a dictionary?
